title: Theoretical and experimental study of counter-rotating shrouded rotors.
author: Davi Miranda Quixadá
abstract: Counter-rotating shrouded rotors are a solution used in a category of MAVs (Micro-Air Vehicles) of vertical take-off/landing. This is an area of recent development and it takes several studies on the issue to be raised optimization of parameters, including of the steady flight. With the parameters measured in experimental trials, including a study of the airflow (fields of velocity), one can improve the system making changes and choosing the most important parameters. Moreover, this study launches the seed of a new theoretical model that seeks to better represent the system via approximations considered reasonable.
